findings.summary: Implementer report states 'Tests for the change were written and run,' but the diff touches only scripts/convert-pdfs.py and scripts/lib/clean.py — no test file is added or modified, and the repo has no Python test infrastructure at all (no pytest/conftest, no venv, docling isn't even installed in this environment; the only *.test.ts files in the repo are for the unrelated TS modules align.ts/preserve.ts). The regex widening, HTML-unescape/comment-strip ordering, and blank-line collapse are all easily unit-testable and exactly the kind of change the project's TDD/verification rules call for a red→green test on, but no such evidence exists in this diff.
